name: playableads
description: Set up, author and verify Canvas 2D playable ads with the PlayableAds toolkit.

interface.shortDescription: Create and validate lightweight 2D playable ads.
interface.longDescription: Use an existing PlayableAds project or set up a fresh checkout, author a game from a brief, and verify Unity HTML and Google ZIP exports locally. Real campaign and device checks remain manual.
defaultPrompt: Set up a PlayableAds project in a new folder.
Create a 20-second playable ad from my brief.
Verify this game's Unity and Google preview exports.
